title: Ping Monitor

panel.name: Name
panel.bad_host: Enter an IP, a host name or a link
panel.duplicate: This address is already in the list
panel.empty: No devices yet. Press + to add one.
panel.bad_group: Enter a group name that is not used yet

timeout_seconds.label: Ping timeout, s
timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a reply before a device counts as offline.

notify_on_down.label: Notify when a device goes offline
notify_on_down.description: Show an error notification when a device stops answering.

notify_on_recovery.label: Notify when a device comes back
notify_on_recovery.description: Show a notification (and play the sound) when an offline device answers again.

colorize_latency.label: Colour the latency
colorize_latency.description: Green under 100 ms, yellow up to 300 ms, red above. Off: neutral colour.

glyph.label: Bar icon
glyph.description: Icon shown in the bar when every device is online.

columns.label: Cards per row
columns.description: How many device cards sit side by side in the panel.

fail_threshold.label: Failed checks before offline
fail_threshold.description: A device is shown as offline only after this many failed checks in a row. One check sends three pings.

save_failed: Could not save the device list. Your previous list is kept.
save_blocked: config.json could not be read, so changes are not saved to avoid overwriting it. Fix or remove the file, then reopen.
